blocks: In Live 11: there is no Drum Sampler, so pads hold Simpler. In One-Shot mode, Simpler plays the whole sample by default however long the note is held, so a pad that stops early is usually in Classic mode or has Gate on. The pad's context menu saves a pad default, the same as in Live 12, and dragging a configured Simpler into Defaults → Dropping Samples → On Drum Rack also works. Sources: Live 11 Manual: Default Presets for Dropping Samples and Live 11 Manual: One-Shot Playback Mode.
How can I make all the drums in my Ableton/Instrument/Drum Rack be the kind where I press the note and they keep playing?
If a drum still stops early: check its Choke group in the chain list. Any pad in the same choke group cuts it off when it plays, whatever its mode.

In Ableton/Live, a Follow Action decides what happens after a clip or a scene plays, such as playing the next clip in its group (Ableton/Live/UG/16 Launching Clips/07 Follow Actions).
A group is a run of clips in adjacent slots of one track; an empty slot ends the group. Each clip or scene picks between two actions, A and B, by their Chance values.
The ten actions are No Action, Stop, Play Again, Previous, Next, First, Last, Any, Other and Jump.
A Ableton/Live/Action/Follow/Chain sets up several selected clips to play one after another in a loop.

A clip's Follow Action controls sit in the Clip View (Ableton/Live/UG/08 Clip View/03 Extended Clip Properties/01 Follow Action and Launch Controls). A scene's sit in the lower section of the Scene View (Ableton/Live/UG/07 Session View/02 Tracks and Scenes/02 Scene View).
The Enable Follow Actions Globally button, next to the Ableton/Live/UI/Arrangement View/Button/Back to Arrangement, turns every Follow Action in the Set on or off.
The Follow switch in the Control Bar is a separate control that scrolls the Arrangement with playback.

In Ableton/Live, a Follow Action Chain sets several selected clips to play one after another in a loop, using Ableton/Live/Action/Follow. The clips need not sit in adjacent slots (Ableton/Live/UG/16 Launching Clips/07 Follow Actions/02 Creating Cycles).
Create Follow Action Chain is in a clip's context menu, or press Cmd+Shift+Enter: Ableton/Live/Action/Follow/Chain/Keyshort/Create from Selected Clips.
Giving every clip in a group the Next action makes a similar cycle among adjacent clips.
